1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP 双核启动适配方案
2: 
3: > 文档状态：基于当前单核 OpenVela 移植、`bk_avdk_smp` AP SMP 源码和当前
4: > NuttX SMP 框架的源码分析方案。本文只描述物理 CPU1/CPU2 上的 AP SMP
5: > 适配，不改变物理 CPU0/CP 固件。寄存器写入序列、CPU2 安全状态和启动超时
6: > 必须通过实板读回与压力测试闭环后才能作为正式交付基线。
7: 
8: ## 1. 目标与结论
9: 
10: 当前项目已经完成物理 CPU1 上的 OpenVela 单核启动、Mailbox 日志、GPIO、PWM
11: 以及 16 MB PSRAM 的容量布局和 MPU 映射基线。本方案的目标是在不破坏现有 CP
12: 固件、分区、打包和外设功能的前提下，将 OpenVela AP 从单核扩展为物理
13: CPU1+CPU2 双核 NuttX SMP。
14: 
15: 本文是现有资料的 SMP 增量方案，不重复定义单核基础移植和打包规则：
16: 
17: - `BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md`：AP 单核启动、内存、Mailbox/PWC、日志
18:   和基础芯片层方案。
19: - `固件构建步骤.md`：当前已验证的 OpenVela AP + Armino CP 最终固件构建流程。
20: - `BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md`：只描述从当前单核基线扩展到 AP 双核。
21: 
22: 最重要的架构结论如下：
23: 
24: 1. BK7258 全芯片仍是 AMP：物理 CPU0 运行 Armino CP，AP 运行 OpenVela。
25: 2. AP 内部是 SMP：物理 CPU1 和 CPU2 运行同一个 `nuttx.bin`、共享同一个
26:    NuttX 实例、同一地址空间和同一调度器。
27: 3. CPU2 不需要独立分区和独立镜像。最终包仍只有一个 AP 输入 `app1.bin`。
28: 4. 物理 CPU1 是 AP primary，由物理 CPU0/CP 按现有流程启动；物理 CPU2 是
29:    AP secondary，由物理 CPU1 在 NuttX `nx_smp_start()` 阶段启动。
30: 5. 不能只在 `defconfig` 打开 `CONFIG_SMP`。当前芯片层还必须实现次核入口、
31:    核 ID、每核中断栈、CPU2 私有 NVIC/MPU/VTOR 初始化、Mailbox IPI、
32:    `up_cpu_start()`、`up_send_smp_sched()` 和 SMP 安全的原子操作后端。
33: 6. 双核配置启动 CPU2 失败时不得静默退回单核。NuttX 已按两个 CPU 初始化
34:    per-CPU 调度状态，缺失 NuttX logical CPU1 会破坏调度器不变量，应停止 AP 启动并输出
35:    明确诊断。
36: 
37: ### 1.1 结论可信度
38: 
39: | 结论 | 状态 | 依据或后续动作 |
40: | --- | --- | --- |
41: | AP SMP 是物理 CPU1+CPU2 | 已由源码确认 | AVDK AP `CONFIG_CPU_CNT=2`、`CONFIG_SOC_SMP=y` |
42: | CPU1/CPU2 共享一个 AP 镜像 | 已由源码确认 | AVDK 单 AP ELF 含 primary/secondary vectors |
43: | CPU2 由 CPU1 设置 boot offset 后释放 | 已由源码确认 | `reset_cpu2_core()` 和 SMP scheduler port |
44: | NuttX 需要 `up_cpu_start()` 和 IPI hooks | 已由源码确认 | `nx_smp_start()`、NuttX SMP scheduler API |
45: | AP physical channel 1/2 的 FIFO 为 3+3 | 已由源码确认 | AVDK `mbox0_drv.c` SMP 配置 |
46: | CPU2 与 CPU1 使用相同 Secure alias/SAU 表 | 强工程假设 | 参考 `SystemInitCpu1()`，必须实板读回 |
47: | CPU2 reset bit 写 1 表示释放运行 | 由参考行为确认 | 寄存器文字有歧义，必须读回 run status |
48: | 100 ms CPU2 启动超时足够 | 待实测 | 首版可配置到 500 ms，统计实际启动分布 |
49: | AP_SPINLOCK atomic gate 满足所有并发场景 | 待压力验证 | 必须执行 DMA/Audio/双核原子压力测试 |

51: ## 2. 适配边界
52: 
53: ### 2.1 CPU 编号必须固定
54: 
55: 本文同时涉及全芯片物理编号、AVDK AP 内部编号和 NuttX 逻辑编号，必须使用
56: 下表，不允许在代码和日志中混用：
57: 
58: | 全芯片物理核 | AVDK AP 名称 | NuttX 逻辑 CPU | 角色 |
59: | --- | --- | ---: | --- |
60: | CPU0 | 不属于 AP SMP | 不可见 | Armino CP、系统控制、AP 镜像启动 |
61: | CPU1 | AP `core0` | 0 | OpenVela primary、系统 tick、CP 通信和外设 owner |
62: | CPU2 | AP `core1` | 1 | OpenVela secondary、通用任务执行 |
63: 
64: 代码中建议显式定义转换，避免散落的 `+1`、`-1`：
65: 
66: ```c
67: #define BK7258_AP_NCPUS              2
68: #define BK7258_PHYS_CPU1             1
69: #define BK7258_PHYS_CPU2             2
70: 
71: #define BK7258_LOGICAL_TO_PHYS(cpu)  ((cpu) + 1)
72: #define BK7258_PHYS_TO_LOGICAL(cpu)  ((cpu) - 1)
73: ```
74: 
75: ### 2.2 保持不变的部分
76: 
77: 以下内容不因 AP 双核而改变：
78: 
79: - 物理 CPU0/CP 固件和 `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`。
80: - Bootloader 和 CPU0 启动 CPU1 的流程。
81: - `primary_ap_app` 分区和 AP XIP 起始地址 `0x02150000`。
82: - AP 私有 RAM `0x28010000..0x28063fff`。
83: - 最终包中的 AP 文件名和角色：`package/tmp/app1.bin`。
84: - `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 打包接口。
85: - CP UART0 与 AP Mailbox UART 日志链路。
86: - 当前 GPIO/PWM 寄存器和板级引脚配置。
87: - 首版继续关闭 I-cache、D-cache、PSRAM cacheable 属性和动态 DVFS；16 MB
88:   PSRAM 硬件窗口可以保持映射，但 allocator、媒体 pool 和静态 section 必须按
89:   PSRAM 方案的状态门禁启用。
90: 
91: ### 2.3 本方案不包含
92: 
93: - 不把 CPU0 与 CPU1 组成 NuttX SMP。
94: - 不为 CPU2 增加 `app2.bin`、Flash 分区或独立链接地址。
95: - 不把 AVDK FreeRTOS SMP port 与 NuttX 混链。
96: - 不直接编译 AVDK 的 `startup_cpu1.c`、`port.c` 或 FreeRTOS spinlock。
97: - 不在首版实现 CPU2 hotplug、CPU2 独立掉电和 SMP suspend/resume。
98: - 不在双核启动阶段同时打开 cacheable PSRAM、Wi-Fi、BT 或媒体服务。PSRAM 的
99:   16 MB non-cacheable MPU 映射可以保留，但不能把它等同于 allocator 已上线。
100: - 不承诺现有所有板级驱动已天然支持任务在两个 CPU 之间迁移。
101: 
102: ## 3. 源码确认的参考启动机制
103: 
104: ### 3.1 全芯片启动链
105: 
106: 当前完整启动链保持为：
107: 
108: ```text
109: Bootloader
110:   -> 物理 CPU0/CP Armino
111:      -> start_cpu1_core()
112:         -> 设置 AP 分区 XIP 地址
113:         -> CPU1 power on / boot offset / reset release
114:            -> OpenVela __start()，NuttX 逻辑 CPU0
115:               -> nx_start()
116:                  -> nx_smp_start()
117:                     -> up_cpu_start(1)
118:                        -> CPU2 power on / boot offset / reset release
119:                           -> bk7258_secondary_start()
120:                              -> nx_idle_trampoline()
121:                  -> nx_bringup()
122:                     -> Mailbox/PWC ready
123:                     -> NSH
124: ```
125: 
126: CP 启动 AP 的现有依据：
127: 
128: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`
129: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:143-196`
130: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c`
131: 
132: NuttX 启动次核的公共调用链：
133: 
134: - `contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:796-815`
135: - `contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_smpstart.c:118-141`
136: 
137: ### 3.2 AVDK AP SMP 的直接证据
138: 
139: `bk_avdk_smp` 的 AP 默认配置明确启用两个 AP 执行核：
140: 
141: ```text
142: CONFIG_CPU_CNT=2
143: CONFIG_SOC_SMP=y
144: CONFIG_FREERTOS_SMP=y
145: ```
146: 
147: 来源：
148: 
149: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:13-14`
150: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:164-168`
151: 
152: AVDK 的 AP primary 在调度器启动时调用
153: `multicore_launch_core1()`，后者把同一 AP ELF 内的 secondary vector 地址交给
154: CPU2：
155: 
156: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/GCC/ARM_CM33_NTZ/non_secure/port.c:1202-1222`
157: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:259-318`
158: 
159: 这里 AVDK 文件名 `startup_cpu1.c` 指 AP 逻辑 core1，即全芯片物理 CPU2，不能
160: 误解为 CP 启动的物理 CPU1 primary。
161: 
162: ### 3.3 CPU2 硬件释放顺序
163: 
164: 参考实现 `reset_cpu2_core()` 执行：
165: 
166: ```text
167: clear CPU2 power-down
168: select CPU2 RXEVT path
169: write CPU2 boot address offset = vector_address >> 8
170: release CPU2 software reset
171: ```
172: 
173: 依据：
174: 
175: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:205-228`
176: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c:99-120`
177: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_driver.c:362-365`
178: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sys_reg.h:143-167`
179: 
180: CPU2 控制寄存器位于 `SOC_SYS_REG_BASE + 0x18`，即当前 Secure alias 下的
181: `0x44010018`。关键字段为：
182: 
183: | 字段 | bit | 参考语义 |
184: | --- | ---: | --- |
185: | `CPU2_SW_RST` | 0 | AVDK 使用 1 释放运行、0 保持 reset |
186: | `CPU2_PWR_DW` | 1 | 0 清除 power-down |
187: | `CPU2_RXEVT_SEL` | 5 | SMP 路径设置为 1 |
188: | `CPU2_OFFSET` | 8..31 | 启动向量地址右移 8 位 |
189: 
190: 寄存器注释和 API 命名对 bit0 的文字存在歧义，OpenVela 实现应复现 AVDK 的
191: 实际写入顺序，并在实板上读回 CPU run status；不能只依据字段名反向推断电平。
192:

194: 
195: 当前 OpenVela 芯片层位于：
196: 
197: ```text

204:

206: - `bk7258_vectors.c`：Flash boot vector 和 RAM runtime vector。

208: - `bk7258_timerisr.c`：CPU1 SysTick lower-half。
209: - `bk7258_mbox0.c`、`bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`：CPU1 channel 1 与 CP 通信。

211: - 单个 AP raw binary 到 `all-app.bin` 的完整打包链。

213: 当前双核缺口：
214: 
215: | 模块 | 当前状态 | 双核所需增量 |
216: | --- | --- | --- |
217: | Kconfig | `CONFIG_SMP` 关闭 | 声明 multicore，固定 NCPUS=2 |

226: | 原子操作 | 未验证跨核 | 增加 BK7258 atomic hwspinlock backend |
227: | 驱动锁 | 多处只关本地 IRQ | 转为 spinlock 或固定 CPU0 owner |
228: | PSRAM 硬件窗口 | 已增加 16 MB MPU 映射 | 两核必须配置一致，仍为 non-cacheable/XN |
229: | PSRAM allocator | 基础已接入 | AP heap 和四个媒体 pool 已实现基线；双核状态锁、PWC query 和容量门禁完成后正式启用 |

234: ### 4.1 当前 16 MB PSRAM 基线
235: 
236: 当前工作区已经增加以下硬件和构建基线：

250: | 区域 | 地址范围 | 大小 | owner |
251: | --- | --- | ---: | --- |

342: ## 7. 链接与内存方案
343: 
344: ### 7.1 分区不变
345: 
346: 仍使用：
347: 
348: ```text
349: FLASH: 0x02150000, size 0x00110000
350: RAM:   0x28010000, size 0x00054000
351: ```
352: 
353: 不新增 CPU2 RAM 分区。CPU1 和 CPU2 共享 `.text`、`.data`、`.bss` 和 heap。
354: 
355: ### 7.2 AP_SPINLOCK 保留区
356: 
357: `app_ab` 已在 AP RAM 之前保留：
358: 
359: ```text
360: AP_SPINLOCK: 0x28000000, size 0x00010000
361: ```
362: 
363: 双核链接脚本应把它声明为独立 MEMORY 区域，不得并入 NuttX heap：
364: 
365: ```ld
366: SPINLOCK (rw) : ORIGIN = 0x28000000, LENGTH = 0x00010000
367: ```
368: 
369: 首版只在该区放置一个 NuttX atomic gate 和必要诊断字：
370: 
371: ```ld
372: .bk_smp_lock (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(32)
373: {
374:   __bk_smp_lock_start = .;
375:   KEEP(*(.bk_smp_lock))
376:   __bk_smp_lock_end = .;
377: } > SPINLOCK
378: ```
379: 
380: primary 必须在调用 `nx_start()` 前初始化该锁，因为 `tasklist_initialize()` 等
381: NuttX 早期路径在 SMP 配置下已经会使用 atomic；不能等到 `up_cpu_start()` 才
382: 初始化。不要在 CPU2 启动后清零该区域。
383: 最终应从 `ram_regions.csv` 生成地址宏，而不是长期维护第二份硬编码布局。
384: 
385: AVDK 的实际 AP map 也将 `.sram_spinlock_section` 放在 `0x28000000`，可核对：
386: 
387: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/app.map`
388: 
389: ### 7.3 CPU2 boot vector
390: 
391: 在 Flash 中增加一份只用于 CPU2 reset 的 vector，512 字节对齐：
392: 
393: ```ld
394: .bk_secondary_vectors : ALIGN(512)
395: {
396:   __bk_secondary_vectors = .;
397:   KEEP(*(.bk_secondary_vectors))
398:   . = ALIGN(512);
399: } > FLASH
400: ```
401: 
402: CPU2 控制寄存器只保存地址的高 24 位，因此 vector 至少要 256 字节对齐；为同时
403: 满足 Cortex-M33 VTOR 约束，统一使用 512 字节对齐并增加链接断言。
404: 
405: secondary boot vector 的前两个 word：
406: 
407: ```text
408: word 0: __secondary_boot_stack_top
409: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
410: ```
411: 
412: CPU2 启动后切换到共享的完整 RAM runtime vector。CPU2 boot vector 不包含 BK
413: legacy magic；只有 AP 镜像 offset 0 的 primary boot vector 保留 magic。
414: 
415: ### 7.4 每核栈
416: 
417: 至少显式保留：
418: 
419: - NuttX logical CPU0 idle stack：沿用当前 `__idle_stack_*`。
420: - NuttX logical CPU1 idle stack：由 `up_cpu_idlestack()` 从 NuttX heap 分配。
421: - NuttX logical CPU0 interrupt stack：`CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK`。
422: - NuttX logical CPU1 interrupt stack：`CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK`。
423: - CPU2 bootstrap stack：建议 1024 字节，只使用到切换至 idle/interrupt stack。
424: 
425: ARM-M 公共 `arm_exception.S` 在 `CONFIG_SMP` 下不会创建单核
426: `g_intstackalloc`，BK7258 芯片层必须分配两个中断栈并实现：
427: 
428: ```c
429: uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu);
430: int up_cpu_idlestack(int cpu, struct tcb_s *tcb, size_t stack_size);
431: ```
432: 
433: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 按 RP2040 等 Cortex-M SMP 平台的方式调用
434: `up_create_stack()`，并让 NuttX idle TCB 持有该分配；不要再为 secondary idle
435: 线程手工维护另一份静态永久栈。参考：
436: 
437: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/rp2040/rp2040_cpuidlestack.c:83-89`
438: 
439: 中断栈参考：
440: 
441: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_exception.S:341-358`
442: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/rp2040/rp2040_irq.c:49-77`
443: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/rp2040/rp2040_irq.c:441-454`
444: 
445: 链接脚本必须断言所有静态区、两个中断栈和 bootstrap stack 均在
446: `0x28010000..0x28063fff` 内，heap 不得覆盖它们。
447: 
448: ## 8. 核 ID 实现
449: 
450: AVDK 使用每核私有 DTCM 地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP 逻辑 core ID：
451: 
452: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Include/cpu_id.h:17-22`
453: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/smp.c:20-33`
454: 
455: OpenVela 采用同一硬件事实，但保存 NuttX 逻辑 ID：
456: 
457: ```text
458: 物理 CPU1 的私有 0x20000000 = 0
459: 物理 CPU2 的私有 0x20000000 = 1
460: ```
461: 
462: 实现：
463: 
464: ```c
465: int up_cpu_index(void)
466: {
467:   return *(volatile uint32_t *)BK7258_CPU_ID_ADDR;
468: }
469: ```
470: 
471: 约束：
472: 
473: 1. primary 在 `bk7258_start()` 调用任何 `this_cpu()`、per-CPU 或 NuttX API 前写 0。
474: 2. secondary 在调用任何 NuttX API 前写 1。
475: 3. 该地址是每个 M33 的私有 DTCM 视图，不是 AP shared RAM。
476: 4. 启动时断言读值小于 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS`。
477: 5. Mailbox 使用物理 channel 1/2；NuttX 调度器使用逻辑 CPU 0/1，转换必须显式。
478: 
479: ## 9. CPU2 启动实现
480: 
481: ### 9.1 `up_cpu_start(1)`
482: 
483: NuttX 在完成 task、memory、IRQ、clock、driver 和 idle TCB 初始化后调用
484: `up_cpu_start(1)`。此时 secondary idle TCB 和栈已存在：
485: 
486: - `contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:426-461`
487: - `contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:805-815`
488: 
489: 建议流程：
490: 
491: ```text
492: up_cpu_start(1)
493:   -> 校验 cpu == 1、当前逻辑 CPU == 0
494:   -> 获取 current_task(1) 的 idle stack top
495:   -> 发布 secondary idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
496:   -> 清启动状态，DMB/DSB
497:   -> 确认 board early 已完成 Mailbox channel 1/2 全局 FIFO 配置
498:   -> CPU2 保持 reset 时清 CPU2 系统中断路由并准备 IPI route
499:   -> CPU2_PWR_DW = 0
500:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL = 1
501:   -> CPU2_OFFSET = __bk_secondary_vectors >> 8
502:   -> DSB/ISB
503:   -> CPU2_SW_RST = 1，释放运行
504:   -> 有界等待 secondary online flag
505:   -> 成功返回 0；超时记录寄存器并进入 fatal/panic
506: ```
507: 
508: 启动等待必须有界，禁止 AVDK 中仅用于原型的固定空循环。建议首版超时
509: 100 ms，并允许配置到 500 ms；超时时输出：
510: 
511: - CPU2 control register。
512: - CPU current run status。
513: - CPU2 IRQ route 0-31/32-63。
514: - Mailbox channel 2 config/status。
515: - secondary boot stage。
516: 
517: NuttX 没有运行时把 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2` 降为 1 的安全路径。CPU2 超时后不得
518: 继续 `nx_bringup()`。特别注意 `nx_start()` 当前通过
519: `DEBUGVERIFY(nx_smp_start())` 调用 SMP 启动；关闭 debug assertions 时表达式仍会
520: 执行，但负返回值不保证终止启动。因此正式固件的 `up_cpu_start()` 超时路径应
521: 在输出诊断后调用 panic/fatal 停机，不能仅依赖返回 `-ETIMEDOUT`。测试构建可以
522: 保留错误返回用于单元测试，但上板 SMP 配置必须 fail-stop。
523: 
524: ### 9.2 Secondary reset 入口
525: 
526: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 必须与 primary 的全局 C runtime 初始化严格分离：
527: 
528: ```text
529: CPU2 reset vector
530:   -> cpsid i
531:   -> 使用 bootstrap MSP/MSPLIM
532:   -> 写 NuttX logical CPU ID = 1
533:   -> 配置 CP10/CP11 和 FPU barrier
534:   -> 配置 CPU2 私有 SAU/TCM/fault 基线
535:   -> 配置与 primary 一致的 MPU region
536:   -> 设置 VTOR = __ram_vectors_start
537:   -> 清 CPU2 私有 NVIC enable/pending，设置 priority
538:   -> 只启用 CPU2 Mailbox IPI 路由和私有 NVIC line 63
539:   -> 切换 PSP = secondary idle stack top
540:   -> 切换 MSP = CPU2 interrupt stack top
541:   -> sched_note_cpu_started()
542:   -> 开中断
543:   -> 设置在线状态，DMB/SEV
544:   -> nx_idle_trampoline()，不得返回
545: ```
546: 
547: reset 到 CP10/CP11 enable 之间的函数必须使用 `target("general-regs-only")` 或纯
548: 汇编，不能让 hard-float ABI 生成任何提前的浮点指令。FPU enable 后执行 DSB/ISB，
549: 再进入普通 hard-float C 代码；该约束与当前 primary `bk7258_start()` 一致。
550: 
551: CPU2 禁止重复执行：
552: 
553: - `.data` 复制和 `.bss` 清零。
554: - NuttX heap、task list、IRQ table 和 driver 全局初始化。
555: - `nx_start()`。
556: - `up_timer_initialize()`。
557: - Mailbox device global soft reset/FIFO 全局重配。
558: - board bring-up、GPIO、PWM、PWC ready。
559: 
560: ### 9.3 栈切换
561: 
562: boot vector 的静态 bootstrap stack 只用于 CPU2 的早期 C 初始化。进入 NuttX
563: idle trampoline 前，必须用不可返回的汇编尾部完成：
564: 
565: 1. PSP 指向 NuttX logical CPU1 idle TCB 的 stack top。
566: 2. PSPLIM 按实际硬件 stack-check 配置设置或清零。
567: 3. MSP 指向 logical CPU1 interrupt stack top。
568: 4. MSPLIM 指向对应 interrupt stack base。
569: 5. `CONTROL.SPSEL=1`，线程模式使用 PSP。
570: 6. `ISB` 后跳转 `nx_idle_trampoline()`。
571: 
572: 不能让 secondary 长期使用 bootstrap stack，也不能让两个 CPU 共用 MSP。
573: 
574: ## 10. 每核私有初始化
575: 
576: ### 10.1 SAU、MPU、FPU 和 TCM
577: 
578: Cortex-M33 的 SCB、SAU、MPU、NVIC、SysTick、ITCM/DTCM 控制均为每核私有
579: 状态。CPU2 至少复现 primary 已验证的：
580: 
581: - CP10/CP11 full access。
582: - Secure alias 和当前 SAU 表。
583: - MPU Flash、AP RAM、peripheral 和必要 shared window 属性。
584: - VTOR 与 fault enable。
585: - 必要 ITCM/DTCM enable。
586: 
587: 首版不链接 `.itcm`、`.dtcm` 可执行或普通数据 section，也不调用 AVDK 的 TCM
588: loader。DTCM 只使用已经确认的每核私有 CPU ID word；启用 DTCM 后必须先验证
589: `0x20000000` 在两个物理核上确实是不同存储实例。
590: 
591: `.data`、`.bss`、heap 和驱动只由 primary 初始化一次；私有架构寄存器则必须
592: 每核初始化。建议把 `bk7258_start.c` 中可复用的纯私有寄存器配置抽成
593: `bk7258_core_arch_initialize()`，由 primary 和 secondary 调用；全局 C runtime
594: 代码仍只留在 primary。
595: 
596: 16 MB PSRAM 需要特别处理：CPU2 必须安装与 CPU1 完全相同的 PSRAM MPU region，
597: 但不能在 secondary reset 入口 probe、清零、建立 `mm_heap_s` 或重建媒体 pool。
598: PSRAM allocator handle、状态、generation、lease 和统计必须留在 AP SRAM；CPU2
599: 只能在 allocator ONLINE 后通过 SMP-safe API 使用 AP heap 或对应媒体 pool。
600: 如果 `AP_PSRAM_SECTION` 后续放入静态对象，CPU2 只继承该映射，不能复制
601: `.psram.data`、清零 `.psram.bss` 或执行任何 PSRAM 上电动作。
602: 
603: ### 10.2 Cache
604: 
605: 首版两个核均保持 I-cache、D-cache 关闭。原因：
606: 
607: - Mailbox envelope、日志交换 buffer、SMP 控制块和关键栈仍依赖 shared SRAM。
608: - NuttX task、TCB、ready queue 和 spinlock 均跨核共享。
609: - PSRAM 16 MB 当前虽已映射，但仍按 non-cacheable/XN 数据窗口使用。
610: - 当前驱动没有完整的 cache ownership/clean/invalidate 协议。
611: 
612: 双核稳定后才能单独立项开启 cache。开启前必须验证 AP SRAM coherent 属性，或
613: 把 scheduler、spinlock、Mailbox buffer 放入 non-cacheable region，并补齐所有
614: 所有权转移 barrier。
615: 
616: ## 11. IRQ 与外设 owner
617: 
618: ### 11.1 拆分全局与每核初始化
619: 
620: 当前 `up_irqinitialize()` 同时操作 NuttX 全局 IRQ table、CPU1 私有 NVIC 和
621: CPU1 route 寄存器。双核下拆成：
622: 
623: ```text
624: up_irqinitialize()                 # 只由 primary 调用一次
625:   -> 清 CPU1/CPU2 外设 route baseline
626:   -> 注册 NuttX exception handlers
627:   -> bk7258_nvic_local_initialize(0)
628: 
629: bk7258_secondary_start()
630:   -> bk7258_nvic_local_initialize(1)
631:   -> 只启用 CPU2 IPI
632: ```
633: 
634: secondary 不得再次 `irq_attach()` 全局 exception handler，也不得清 CPU1 route。
635: 
636: ### 11.2 CPU2 route 寄存器
637: 
638: 当前 header 只有 CPU1 route：
639: 
640: ```text
641: CPU1 IRQ EN0: 0x44010088
642: CPU1 IRQ EN1: 0x4401008c
643: ```
644: 
645: 需增加：
646: 
647: ```text
648: CPU2 IRQ EN0: 0x44010090
649: CPU2 IRQ EN1: 0x44010094
650: ```
651: 
652: 依据：
653: 
654: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sys_reg.h:1084-1182`
655: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sys_reg.h:1272-1370`
656: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sys_hal.c:609-697`
657: 
658: ### 11.3 首版 owner 表
659: 
660: | 资源 | NuttX owner | 路由策略 |
661: | --- | ---: | --- |
662: | SysTick | 逻辑 CPU0 | 只有 primary 产生系统 tick |
663: | Mailbox source 63 | CPU0和CPU1 | 每个物理 channel 硬绑定对应核，用于 CP 和 IPI |
664: | GPIO/button | 逻辑 CPU0 | 外部 IRQ 只路由物理 CPU1 |
665: | PWM | 逻辑 CPU0 | 控制 API 首版固定 CPU0 |
666: | UART1 临时路径 | 逻辑 CPU0 | 不路由 CPU2，正式日志仍走 Mailbox |
667: | 其他外设 | 逻辑 CPU0 | 未审计前禁止 CPU2 owner |
668: 
669: 不能把同一有状态外设 IRQ 同时路由到两个核。Mailbox 是例外，因为硬件 channel
670: 1/2 各自有 FIFO，统一 source 63 在每个核上处理本核 channel。
671: 
672: ## 12. Mailbox IPI 设计
673: 
674: ### 12.1 与 CP logical channel 分层
675: 
676: Mailbox v2 的三条物理 channel：
677: 
678: | 物理 channel | owner | SMP FIFO 配置 |
679: | ---: | --- | --- |
680: | 0 | 物理 CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
681: | 1 | 物理 CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
682: | 2 | 物理 CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
683: 
684: 依据：
685: 
686: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:6-27`
687: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:147-173`
688: 
689: 消息分类沿用 AVDK：
690: 
691: ```text
692: data[1] != 0: 指针 + 长度 envelope，交给 CP/AP logical channel transport
693: data[1] == 0: AP 内部 raw cross-core command，交给 SMP IPI handler
694: ```
695: 
696: 依据：
697: 
698: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:51-71`
699: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_cross_core.c:22-45`
700: 
701: CPU2 不参与 CP 的 PWC、heartbeat 和 Mailbox UART logical channel；这些服务仍由
702: physical CPU1/NuttX logical CPU0 负责。
703: 
704: ### 12.2 改造当前物理驱动
705: 
706: 当前 `bk7258_mbox0.c` 固定访问 channel 1。双核需改为：
707: 
708: - `board_early_initialize()` 调用 `bk7258_smp_early_initialize()`，在
709:   `nx_smp_start()` 前配置 channel 1/2 FIFO、注册一次全局 IRQ79 handler，并启用
710:   primary 的 channel 1 IRQ。该时点 IRQ table 和 OS 基础服务已可用，CPU2 仍在
711:   reset。
712: - `up_cpu_start()` 只补充 CPU2 私有 route/NVIC 和启动状态，不对 Mailbox device
713:   执行 soft reset 或重新划分全局 FIFO。
714: - 收发寄存器按 `BK7258_LOGICAL_TO_PHYS(up_cpu_index())` 选择 channel 1/2。
715: - CPU1/primary 收到 `data[1] != 0` 时进入现有 logical channel callback。
716: - 任一 AP 核收到 `data[1] == 0` 时进入 SMP IPI handler。
717: - secondary 禁止把 CP envelope 交给 PWC/syslog 状态机。
718: - `bk7258_mailbox_channel.c` 中共享状态的 `up_irq_save()` 保护改为 SMP spinlock，
719:   或把 worker 和所有调用者固定到逻辑 CPU0。
720: 
721: 现有 `board_late_initialize() -> bk7258_pwc_start() -> bk7258_mailbox_init()` 必须
722: 拆层：board late 只建立 CP logical channel、semaphore 和 worker，不再重置物理
723: Mailbox、重配 FIFO 或重复 `irq_attach()`。否则 CPU2 online 后重新初始化 Mailbox
724: 会丢 IPI，并可能清除正在进行的 NuttX SMP call。
725: 
726: 生命周期依据：
727: 
728: - `contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:658-735`
729: - `contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:805-815`
730: - `contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_boot.c`
731: - `contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c`
732: 
733: ### 12.3 NuttX SMP hooks
734: 
735: `bk7258_smpcall.c` 实现：
736: 
737: ```c
738: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
739: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
740: ```
741: 
742: 目标核 IPI ISR 执行：
743: 
744: ```c
745: nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg);
746: nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu());
747: ```
748: 
749: 参考 NuttX 双 Cortex-M 实现：
750: 
751: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/sam34/sam4cm_smpcall.c:69-155`
752: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/rp2040/rp2040_smpcall.c:91-184`
753: 
754: 建议 raw command 使用 pending bit 合并 `SCHED` 和 `CALL`，发送前 DMB，ISR 清
755: pending 后 DMB。Mailbox FIFO full 不能静默丢 IPI；首版应采用有界短轮询并记录
756: 计数，超过硬限制视为 fatal SMP transport error。不得在持有会被目标 IPI handler
757: 获取的 NuttX spinlock 时无限等待。

759: ## 13. 原子操作与 spinlock
760: 
761: ### 13.1 为什么不能只打开 `CONFIG_SPINLOCK`
762: 
763: NuttX SMP 会在 scheduler、critical section、queue、semaphore 和 driver 中大量
764: 使用 `atomic_t`/`spinlock_t`。默认 toolchain atomic 可能在每个普通 AP SRAM
765: lock word 上执行 exclusive load/store。BK7258 AVDK 明确把 spinlock 对象集中到
766: 专用 `AP_SPINLOCK` 区，以规避 SRAM exclusive monitor 与其他 bus master 的已知
767: 约束。
768: 
769: 因此以下配置不足：
770: 
771: ```text
772: CONFIG_SMP=y
773: CONFIG_SPINLOCK=y
774: ```
775: 
776: ### 13.2 首版正确性优先方案
777: 
778: 采用 NuttX `LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK` 框架：
779: 
780: 1. 在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放一个 atomic gate word。
781: 2. `bk7258_hwspinlock.c` 用经 AVDK 验证的 LDAXR/STXR 或等价 CMSIS acquire/release
782:    序列实现 `trylock/relax/unlock`。
783: 3. `bk7258_atomic.c` 导出 `g_atomic_hwspinlock`。
784: 4. NuttX `arch_atomic.c` 在该 gate 保护下对普通 `atomic_t` 做 load/store/exchange。
785: 5. unlock 使用 release store、DSB 和 SEV；wait 路径使用有界诊断和 WFE。
786: 
787: 框架依据：
788: 
789: - `contest/nuttx/libs/libc/machine/arch_atomic.c:324-345`
790: - `contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/hwspinlock/hwspinlock.h:40-113`
791: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/lc823450/lc823450_atomic.c`
792: - `contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/lc823450/lc823450_hwspinlock.c`
793: 
794: 该方案会串行化所有 NuttX atomic，性能不是最优，但首版最小且便于证明正确性。
795: 双核稳定后，只有在 BK7258 exclusive 范围和 DMA 并发测试完成后，才评估改为
796: 直接 architecture atomic。

798: ### 13.3 验收要求
799: 
800: - 两核并发原子加一，最终计数精确一致。
801: - 两核反复进入 NuttX critical section，不死锁。
802: - DMA、Audio 或其他 bus master 压力下不出现无提示数据丢失。
803: - 记录 atomic gate 最大等待时间和超时次数。
804: - `AP_SPINLOCK` 不被 heap、CP RAM、Mailbox exchange buffer 或普通 `.bss` 覆盖。
805: 
806: ## 14. 系统 tick 与调度
807: 
808: 首版只由 NuttX logical CPU0 的 SysTick 产生 1 ms 系统 tick。CPU2 不启动第二个
809: SysTick，避免全局时间加倍。
810: 
811: NuttX `nxsched_process_timer()` 会在一次 tick 中处理所有配置 CPU 的 RR/sporadic
812: 调度状态：
813: 
814: - `contest/nuttx/sched/sched/sched_processtimer.c:103-144`
815: - `contest/nuttx/sched/sched/sched_processtimer.c:179-208`
816: 
817: 当目标 CPU 需要切换时，调度器通过 `up_send_smp_sched()` 发送 IPI。因此双核
818: 调度正确性的关键是 primary SysTick + 可靠 IPI，不是两个核各自调用
819: `nxsched_process_timer()`。
820: 
821: 保留：
822: 
823: ```text
824: CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y
825: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
826: CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
827: # CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS is not set
828: ```
829: 
830: ## 15. 现有驱动的 SMP 收敛策略
831: 
832: 双核启动成功不等于所有驱动已 SMP-safe。当前部分驱动用 `up_irq_save()` 保护
833: 共享状态，这只能关闭本地中断，不能阻止另一个 CPU 并发访问。
834: 
835: 首版采用两类处理：
836: 
837: ### 15.1 固定到 logical CPU0
838: 
839: - Mailbox TX worker。
840: - PWC worker、heartbeat 和 ready。
841: - Mailbox UART/syslog flush worker。
842: - GPIO button/motor worker。
843: - PWM 控制任务。
844: - 所有未审计的板级 driver worker。
845: 
846: `kthread_create()` 返回 pid 后立即用 `sched_setaffinity()` 设置 CPU mask `0x1`。
847: 固定 affinity 失败应终止对应 driver bring-up，不能继续宣称 owner 已固定。
848: 
849: ### 15.2 改为 SMP lock
850: 
851: 以下共享状态即使 worker 固定 CPU0，也可能被 CPU2 上的任意任务调用，应使用
852: NuttX spinlock 或 mutex：
853: 
854: - syslog/Mailbox UART ring 的 read/write/inflight index。
855: - Mailbox physical TX 和 channel pending/ACK 状态。
856: - GPIO/PWM 公共寄存器 RMW。
857: - 全局错误统计和 reset 状态。
858: 
859: ISR 与任务共享的数据使用 `spin_lock_irqsave()`；允许睡眠的长操作使用 mutex，
860: 不得在 spinlock 内等待 Mailbox ACK 或执行日志格式化。
861: 
862: ## 16. PWC、日志和 ready 时序
863: 
864: NuttX 的 `nx_smp_start()` 位于 `nx_bringup()` 之前，因此正式时序应为：
865: 
866: ```text
867: CPU1 primary 完成 NuttX hardware initialization
868:   -> nx_smp_start()
869:      -> CPU2 secondary online
870:      -> 双向 IPI 自检成功
871:   -> nx_bringup()
872:      -> GPIO/PWM owner 固定到 logical CPU0
873:      -> CP logical Mailbox/PWC/日志 worker 启动并固定 CPU0
874:      -> IPC power-up indication
875:      -> heartbeat
876:      -> PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD
877:      -> NSH
878: ```
879: 
880: `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` 仍表示整个 AP 已具备持续服务能力。双核配置下必须在
881: CPU2 online 和最小 IPI 自检之后发送 ready；不能先向 CP 声明 ready 再启动
882: secondary。
883: 
884: CP 只关心 AP 的物理 CPU1 power-up/heartbeat，不新增 CPU2 对 CP 的 heartbeat。
885: CPU2 健康状态由 OpenVela AP 内部监控，必要时由 primary 汇总到现有 AP 日志。
886: 
887: ## 17. 分阶段实施
888: 
889: ### 阶段 0：冻结单核基线
890: 
891: 1. 保存当前 `nuttx.bin`、`System.map`、`.config` 和上板日志。
892: 2. 验证单核启动、Mailbox 日志、heartbeat、GPIO 和 PWM。

915: 4. primary 通过 shared stage word 打印 CPU2 各启动阶段。

919: ### 阶段 3：打通 IPI 与 NuttX 调度

922: 2. 把 physical Mailbox 初始化前移到 board early，并从 board late 删除重复初始化。
923: 3. 实现 raw Mailbox IPI 与 NuttX SMP hooks。

925:    验证两核对 PSRAM window 的访问被正确拒绝或处于明确 OFFLINE 状态。
926: 5. 执行双向 SMP call、自旋锁和 affinity 测试。
927: 6. 让无 affinity 测试任务在两个核间迁移。

929: 退出条件：双核调度压力 1 小时，无 lost IPI、死锁、counter mismatch。
930: 
931: ### 阶段 4：恢复现有板级功能
932: 
933: 1. PWC、heartbeat、日志 worker 固定 logical CPU0。
934: 2. Mailbox、syslog、GPIO、PWM 共享状态改为 SMP-safe。
935: 3. 回归 GPIO、PWM、button/motor 和 NSH。
936: 4. CP/AP Mailbox 与 AP 内部 IPI 并发压力测试。

938: 退出条件：现有单核功能全部通过，CPU2 压力不引入 CP heartbeat timeout。

940: ### 阶段 5：长期稳定性
941: 
942: 1. 24 小时双核调度、日志、GPIO/PWM 并发测试。
943: 2. AP reset、全芯片 reset、CP retry 和 Mailbox FIFO full 注入。
944: 3. CPU2 启动失败、IPI 丢失、atomic lock timeout 负向测试。
945: 4. 检查所有 driver worker affinity 和外设 IRQ owner。

947: 退出条件：满足第 20 节全部验收项。

1081: ### 19.3 压力和故障注入

1083: - 连续复位 100 次。
1084: - 两核 100% CPU load 持续 1 小时。
1085: - 两核并发任务创建、退出、semaphore、mutex、work queue。
1086: - Mailbox log 洪泛与 SMP IPI 并发。
1087: - GPIO/PWM 操作与 CPU2 atomic 压力并发。
1088: - PSRAM ONLINE 后两核并发分配、释放、对齐分配和统计。
1089: - CPU2 尝试重复建立 heap 或重建媒体 pool，确认被状态机拒绝。
1090: - PSRAM OFFLINE/recovery 时 CPU2 新分配被拒绝，旧 generation 指针不可继续使用。

1094: - 人为填满目标 FIFO，确认无 silent lost IPI。

1098: ## 20. 完成定义
1099: 
1100: 双核启动适配只有同时满足以下条件才算完成：
1101: 
1102: 1. 最终固件仍由 bootloader、CP `app.bin` 和单个 AP `app1.bin` 组成。
1103: 2. CPU0/CP 不修改即可启动 OpenVela AP primary。
1104: 3. NuttX logical CPU0 稳定启动 physical CPU2/NuttX logical CPU1。
1105: 4. CPU2 使用独立 bootstrap、idle 和 interrupt stack，不与 primary 重叠。
1106: 5. 两个核的 ID、VTOR、NVIC、SAU、MPU、FPU 状态正确。
1107: 6. 双向 NuttX schedule IPI 和 SMP call 连续压力无丢失。
1108: 7. atomic/spinlock 在 DMA/外设并发下无死锁和数据破坏。
1109: 8. 系统只产生一份 1 ms tick，时间不加倍。
1110: 9. PWC、heartbeat 和 Mailbox UART 仍由 logical CPU0 服务且持续稳定。
1111: 10. GPIO、PWM、button/motor 与单核基线行为一致。
1112: 11. CPU2 启动失败或 IPI 失效可在有界时间内检测，且不发送虚假 AP ready。
1113: 12. 连续复位、1 小时压力和 24 小时稳定性测试全部通过。
1114: 13. 两核 PSRAM MPU 属性一致，allocator 仅由 primary 初始化一次，CP heap 不被覆盖。

1116: ## 21. 主要风险与决策点
1117: 
1118: | 风险 | 后果 | 处理 |
1119: | --- | --- | --- |
1120: | CPU2 reset bit 语义误判 | CPU2 不运行或反复 reset | 复现 AVDK 顺序并读回 run status |
1121: | logical/physical ID 混用 | Mailbox 发错 channel、per-CPU 越界 | 统一转换宏和断言 |
1122: | secondary 重复清 `.bss` | primary 运行状态瞬间损坏 | secondary 入口禁止全局 C runtime |
1123: | 两核共用 MSP | 中断嵌套破坏栈 | 两个 interrupt stack 和私有 MSP |
1124: | 默认 atomic 不满足芯片约束 | 随机死锁/数据丢失 | AP_SPINLOCK atomic gate |
1125: | IPI 和 CP 消息混流 | PWC/调度互相误解析 | 用 `data[1]` 分类 raw 与 envelope |
1126: | IPI FIFO full被忽略 | 目标核不调度 | pending合并、有界重试、fatal诊断 |
1127: | 普通外设双路由 | ISR重复执行 | 首版统一CPU0 owner |
1128: | driver只关本地IRQ | 跨核数据竞争 | affinity收敛或spinlock改造 |
1129: | CPU2也启动SysTick | 系统时间加倍 | 只允许logical CPU0 tick |
1130: | cache 或 PSRAM allocator 过早启用 | TCB/queue/mailbox/heap 不一致 | 映射可保留，allocator 等 PWC、状态锁和并发测试完成 |
1131: | CPU2失败后继续单核运行 | SMP调度器状态不完整 | 禁止运行时静默降级 |
1132: 
1133: ## 22. 推荐实施顺序总结
1134: 
1135: 最小正确路径是：
1136: 
1137: ```text
1138: 配置与链接骨架
1139:   -> BK7258 atomic hwspinlock
1140:   -> 核ID与每核中断栈
1141:   -> CPU2 secondary vector/reset/online
1142:   -> channel 2 raw Mailbox IPI
1143:   -> NuttX SMP schedule/call
1144:   -> driver affinity与共享锁
1145:   -> GPIO/PWM/日志/PWC回归
1146:   -> 故障注入和长期压力
1147: ```
1148: 
1149: 不要把 cacheable PSRAM、DVFS、媒体外设或 CPU2 hotplug 混入首次双核启动提交。
1150: 16 MB PSRAM 的 non-cacheable MPU 映射可以作为现有硬件基线保留，但 allocator、
1151: 媒体 pool、PWC power/recovery 和两核并发分配必须分别完成门禁。先证明两个 CPU
1152: 在 cache-off、单 tick、CPU0 外设 owner 模式下能够稳定执行同一个 NuttX 调度器，
1153: 再启用 PSRAM 数据面和性能优化。

88:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
89:   },

99: static void __attribute__((used, noinline, noreturn,
100:                            target("general-regs-only")))
101: bk7258_start(void)
102: {
103:   const uint8_t *src;
104:   uint8_t *dest;
105: 
106:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
107:    * floating-point extension.
108:    */
109: 
110:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
111:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
112:   UP_DSB();
113:   UP_ISB();
114: 
115:   /* Match the current golden SPE SAU setup: the secure alias is retained,
116:    * while the 0x10000000 non-secure alias range is exposed as non-secure.
117:    */
118: 
119:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
120:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
121:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
122:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
123:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
124:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
125:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
126:   UP_DSB();
127:   UP_ISB();
128: 
129:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
130:     {
131:       *dest++ = *src++;
132:     }
133: 
134:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
135:     {
136:       *dest++ = 0;
137:     }
138: 
139:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
140:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
141:     {
142:       *dest++ = *src++;
143:     }
144: 
145:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
146:   UP_DSB();
147:   UP_ISB();
148: 
149:   /* Install the buffered AP log channel before normal NuttX startup. */
150:   (void)bk7258_syslog_initialize();
151: 
152: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
153:   {
154:     const size_t region_count = sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions) /
155:                                 sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions[0]);
156:     const uint32_t hardware_regions =
157:       (getreg32(MPU_TYPE) & MPU_TYPE_DREGION_MASK) >>
158:       MPU_TYPE_DREGION_SHIFT;
159: 
160:     if (hardware_regions < region_count)
161:       {
162:         /* A missing shared-memory region would silently widen privileged
163:          * access through PRIVDEFENA.  Refuse to boot rather than claim
164:          * permissions that the hardware did not install.
165:          */
166: 
167:         syslog(LOG_ERR, "BK7258 MPU has %lu regions, needs %zu\n",
168:                (unsigned long)hardware_regions, region_count);
169:         for (; ; )
170:           {
171:           }
172:       }
173: 
174:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "BK7258 MPU regions=%zu/%lu, shared RX RO TX RW\n",
175:            region_count, (unsigned long)hardware_regions);
176:     mpu_reset();
177:     mpu_initialize(g_bk7258_mpu_regions, region_count, false, true);
178:   }
179: #endif

181: #ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
182:   arm_earlyserialinit();
183: #endif

185:   nx_start();

188:     }
189: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_irq.c

5:  ****************************************************************************/
6: 
7: #include <nuttx/config.h>
8: 
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: 
11: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
12: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
13: 
14: #include <arch/arm_m/nvicpri.h>
15: 
16: #include "arm_internal.h"
17: #include "nvic.h"
18: 
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
20: 
21: #define DEFPRIORITY32 \
22:   (NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 24 | \
23:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 16 | \
24:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 8  | \
25:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT)
26: 
27: static inline void bk7258_route_irq(int extirq, bool enable)
28: {
29:   uintptr_t regaddr;
30:   uint32_t bit;
31: 
32:   if (extirq < 32)
33:     {
34:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0;
35:       bit = 1u << extirq;
36:     }
37:   else
38:     {
39:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1;
40:       bit = 1u << (extirq - 32);
41:     }
42: 
43:   if (enable)
44:     {
45:       modifyreg32(regaddr, 0, bit);
46:     }
47:   else
48:     {
49:       modifyreg32(regaddr, bit, 0);
50:     }
51: }
52: 
53: static int bk7258_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
54:                           uintptr_t offset)
55: {
56:   int extirq;
57: 
58:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
59: 
60:   if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
61:     {
62:       extirq = irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
63:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(extirq) + offset;
64:       *bit = 1u << (extirq & 31);
65:       return OK;
66:     }
67: 
68:   *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
69:   switch (irq)
70:     {
71:       case BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT:
72:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
73:         break;
74:       case BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT:
75:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
76:         break;
77:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:
78:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
79:         break;
80:       case BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT:
81:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
82:         break;
83:       case BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK:
84:         *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
85:         *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
86:         break;
87:       default:
88:         return ERROR;
89:     }
90: 
91:   return OK;
92: }
93: 
94: static inline void bk7258_prioritize_svcall(int priority)
95: {
96:   uint32_t regval = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
97:   regval &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_MASK;
98:   regval |= priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT;
99:   putreg32(regval, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
100: }
101: 
102: void up_irqinitialize(void)
103: {
104:   uintptr_t regaddr;
105:   int priority_registers;
106:   int i;
107: 
108:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_EXTIRQ_COUNT; i += 32)
109:     {
110:       putreg32(0xffffffffu, NVIC_IRQ_CLEAR(i));
111:     }
112: 
113:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0);
114:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1);
115: 
116:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);
117:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
118:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
119: 
120:   priority_registers = ((getreg32(NVIC_ICTR) & 0x1f) + 1) * 8;
121:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;
122:   while (priority_registers-- > 0)
123:     {
124:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
125:       regaddr += 4;
126:     }
127: 
128:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
129:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
130:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
131:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
132:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
133:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT, arm_securefault, NULL);
134:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
135:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);
136: 
137:   bk7258_prioritize_svcall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
138:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
139:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT);
140:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT);
141:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT);
142:   up_irq_enable();
143: }
144: 
145: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
146: {
147:   uintptr_t regaddr;
148:   uint32_t regval;
149:   uint32_t bit;
150: 
151:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, 0) == OK)
152:     {
153:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
154:         {
155:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, true);
156:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
157:         }
158:       else
159:         {
160:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
161:           putreg32(regval | bit, regaddr);
162:         }
163:     }
164: }
165: 
166: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
167: {
168:   uintptr_t regaddr;
169:   uint32_t regval;
170:   uint32_t bit;
171: 
172:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit,
173:                      NVIC_IRQ0_31_CLEAR - NVIC_IRQ0_31_ENABLE) == OK)
174:     {
175:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
176:         {
177:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
178:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, false);
179:         }
180:       else
181:         {
182:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
183:           putreg32(regval & ~bit, regaddr);
184:         }
185:     }
186: }
187: 
188: void arm_ack_irq(int irq)
189: {
190: }
191: 
192: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
193: int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority)
194: {
195:   uintptr_t regaddr;
196:   uint32_t regval;
197:   int shift;
198: 
199:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT && irq < NR_IRQS);
200:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned int)priority <= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN);
201: 
202:   if (irq < BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
203:     {
204:       regaddr = NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY(irq);
205:       irq -= 4;
206:     }
207:   else
208:     {
209:       irq -= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
210:       regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY(irq);
211:     }
212: 
213:   shift = (irq & 3) << 3;
214:   regval = getreg32(regaddr);
215:   regval &= ~(0xffu << shift);
216:   regval |= (uint32_t)priority << shift;
217:   putreg32(regval, regaddr);
218:   return OK;
219: }
220: #endif

25:  * bk_avdk_smp release/v3.1.1
26:  * ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sys_types.h's register map comment

34:  * global_ctrl.clk_gate_bypass (an internal I2C1-block clock-gate

37:  * fault), but the state machine never actually runs: START never
38:  * produces any sm_int, exactly matching this driver's observed board
39:  * bring-up symptom (int_status stuck at only the start bit set,
40:  * sm_int never firing) before this bit was added to
41:  * bk7258_i2c1_init(). */

50:  * distinct from qspi_hw_t's own glb_ctrl.soft_reset/bps_clkgate fields

66:  * section 5.1 for the diagnostic trail this was found through. */

35:  * at function-select index 6 -- QSPI1 has no other selectable pin group,

39:  * these pins (CLK/CSN, not data lines) -- PCB net labels are the

21: /****************************************************************************
22:  * Included Files
23:  ****************************************************************************/
24: 
25: #include <nuttx/config.h>
26: 
27: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
28: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
29: 
30: #include <stdio.h>
31: #include <sys/param.h>
32: 
33: #include "nvic.h"
34: #include "systick.h"
35: #include "arm_internal.h"
36: 
37: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_SYSTICK
38: 
39: /****************************************************************************
40:  * Pre-processor definitions
41:  ****************************************************************************/
42: 
43: /* According to what arm specified, we should set the
44:  * RELOAD value to N-1 for a desired systick interval of
45:  * N processor clock cycles.
46:  * Therefore, when reading the RELOAD value, it is important
47:  * to add one clock cycle back.
48:  */
49: #define RELOAD2TIMEOUT(reload) ((reload) + 1)
50: #define TIMEOUT2RELOAD(timeout) ((timeout) - 1)
51: 
52: #define CLAMP_RELOAD(reload) \
53: CLAMP(reload, NVIC_MIN_SYSTICK_CNT, NVIC_MAX_SYSTICK_CNT)
54: 
55: /****************************************************************************
56:  * Private Types
57:  ****************************************************************************/
58: 
59: /* This structure provides the private representation of the "lower-half"
60:  * driver state structure.  This structure must be cast-compatible with the
61:  * timer_lowerhalf_s structure.
62:  */
63: 
64: struct systick_lowerhalf_s
65: {
66:   const struct timer_ops_s *ops;        /* Lower half operations */
67:   uint32_t                  freq;       /* Timer working clock frequency(Hz) */
68:   tccb_t                    callback;   /* Current user interrupt callback */
69:   void                     *arg;        /* Argument passed to upper half callback */
70:   uint32_t                 *next_interval;
71: };
72: 
73: /****************************************************************************
74:  * Private Function Prototypes
75:  ****************************************************************************/
76: 
77: static int systick_start(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_);
78: static int systick_stop(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_);
79: static int systick_getstatus(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
80:                              struct timer_status_s *status);
81: static int systick_settimeout(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
82:                               uint32_t timeout);
83: static void systick_setcallback(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
84:                                 tccb_t callback, void *arg);
85: static int systick_maxtimeout(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
86:                               uint32_t *maxtimeout);
87: 
88: /****************************************************************************
89:  * Private Data
90:  ****************************************************************************/
91: 
92: static const struct timer_ops_s g_systick_ops =
93: {
94:   .start       = systick_start,
95:   .stop        = systick_stop,
96:   .getstatus   = systick_getstatus,
97:   .settimeout  = systick_settimeout,
98:   .setcallback = systick_setcallback,
99:   .maxtimeout  = systick_maxtimeout,
100: };
101: 
102: static struct systick_lowerhalf_s g_systick_lower =
103: {
104:   .ops = &g_systick_ops,
105: };
106: 
107: /****************************************************************************
108:  * Private Functions
109:  ****************************************************************************/
110: 
111: static inline uint64_t usec_from_count(uint32_t count, uint32_t freq)
112: {
113:   return (uint64_t)count * USEC_PER_SEC / freq;
114: }
115: 
116: static inline uint64_t usec_to_count(uint32_t usec, uint32_t freq)
117: {
118:   return (uint64_t)usec * freq / USEC_PER_SEC;
119: }
120: 
121: static bool systick_is_running(void)
122: {
123:   return !!(getreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL) & NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE);
124: }
125: 
126: static bool systick_irq_pending(struct systick_lowerhalf_s *lower)
127: {
128:   if (lower->next_interval)
129:     {
130:       return false; /* Interrupt is in process */
131:     }
132:   else
133:     {
134:       return !!(getreg32(NVIC_INTCTRL) & NVIC_INTCTRL_PENDSTSET);
135:     }
136: }
137: 
138: static int systick_start(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_)
139: {
140:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT);
141:   modifyreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL, 0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE);
142:   return 0;
143: }
144: 
145: static int systick_stop(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_)
146: {
147:   modifyreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE, 0);
148:   return 0;
149: }
150: 
151: static int systick_getstatus(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
152:                              struct timer_status_s *status)
153: {
154:   struct systick_lowerhalf_s *lower = (struct systick_lowerhalf_s *)lower_;
155:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
156: 
157:   status->flags    = lower->callback ? TCFLAGS_HANDLER : 0;
158:   status->flags   |= systick_is_running() ? TCFLAGS_ACTIVE : 0;
159:   status->timeout  = usec_from_count(
160:     RELOAD2TIMEOUT(getreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_RELOAD)), lower->freq);
161:   status->timeleft = usec_from_count(getreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT),
162:                                      lower->freq);
163: 
164:   if (systick_irq_pending(lower))
165:     {
166:       /* Interrupt is pending and the timer wrap happen? */
167: 
168:       if (status->timeleft)
169:         {
170:           /* Make timeout-timeleft equal the real elapsed time */
171: 
172:           status->timeout += status->timeout - status->timeleft;
173:           status->timeleft = 0;
174:         }
175:     }
176:   else if (status->timeleft == 0)
177:     {
178:       status->timeleft = status->timeout;
179:     }
180: 
181:   up_irq_restore(flags);
182:   return 0;
183: }
184: 
185: static int systick_settimeout(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
186:                               uint32_t timeout)
187: {
188:   struct systick_lowerhalf_s *lower = (struct systick_lowerhalf_s *)lower_;
189:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
190: 
191:   if (lower->next_interval)
192:     {
193:       /* If the timer callback is in the process,
194:        * delay the update to timer interrupt handler.
195:        */
196: 
197:       *lower->next_interval = timeout;
198:     }
199:   else
200:     {
201:       uint32_t reload;
202: 
203:       reload = TIMEOUT2RELOAD(usec_to_count(timeout, lower->freq));
204: 
205:       putreg32(CLAMP_RELOAD(reload), NVIC_SYSTICK_RELOAD);
206:       if (systick_is_running())
207:         {
208:           if (reload != getreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT))
209:             {
210:               putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT);
211:             }
212:         }
213:     }
214: 
215:   up_irq_restore(flags);
216:   return 0;
217: }
218: 
219: static void systick_setcallback(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
220:                                 tccb_t callback, void *arg)
221: {
222:   struct systick_lowerhalf_s *lower = (struct systick_lowerhalf_s *)lower_;
223:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
224: 
225:   lower->callback  = callback;
226:   lower->arg       = arg;
227: 
228:   up_irq_restore(flags);
229: }
230: 
231: static int systick_maxtimeout(struct timer_lowerhalf_s *lower_,
232:                               uint32_t *maxtimeout)
233: {
234:   uint64_t maxtimeout64 = usec_from_count(
235:     NVIC_SYSTICK_RELOAD_MASK, g_systick_lower.freq);
236: 
237:   if (maxtimeout64 > UINT32_MAX)
238:     {
239:       *maxtimeout = UINT32_MAX;
240:     }
241:   else
242:     {
243:       *maxtimeout = maxtimeout64;
244:     }
245: 
246:   return 0;
247: }
248: 
249: static int systick_interrupt(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
250: {
251:   struct systick_lowerhalf_s *lower = arg;
252: 
253:   if (lower->callback && systick_is_running())
254:     {
255:       uint32_t reload = getreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_RELOAD);
256:       uint32_t interval = usec_from_count(
257:         RELOAD2TIMEOUT(reload), lower->freq);
258:       uint32_t next_interval = interval;
259: 
260:       lower->next_interval = &next_interval;
261:       if (lower->callback(&next_interval, lower->arg))
262:         {
263:           if (next_interval && next_interval != interval)
264:             {
265:               reload = TIMEOUT2RELOAD(
266:                 usec_to_count(next_interval, lower->freq));
267:               putreg32(CLAMP_RELOAD(reload), NVIC_SYSTICK_RELOAD);
268:               putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT);
269:             }
270:         }
271:       else
272:         {
273:           modifyreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE, 0);
274:         }
275: 
276:       lower->next_interval = NULL;
277:     }
278: 
279:   return 0;
280: }
281: 
282: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_SYSTICK_IRQ_WQUEUE
283: static int systick_isr_handle(int irq, void *regs, void *arg)
284: {
285:   return IRQ_WAKE_THREAD;
286: }
287: #endif
288: 
289: /****************************************************************************
290:  * Public Functions
291:  ****************************************************************************/
292: 
293: struct timer_lowerhalf_s *systick_initialize(bool coreclk,
294:                                              unsigned int freq, int minor)
295: {
296:   struct systick_lowerhalf_s *lower =
297:     (struct systick_lowerhalf_s *)&g_systick_lower;
298: 
299:   /* Calculate the working clock frequency if need */
300: 
301:   if (freq == 0)
302:     {
303:       uint32_t calib = getreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CALIB);
304:       uint32_t tenms = calib & NVIC_SYSTICK_CALIB_TENMS_MASK;
305:       lower->freq = 100 * (tenms + 1);
306:     }
307:   else
308:     {
309:       lower->freq = freq;
310:     }
311: 
312:   /* Disable SYSTICK, but enable interrupt */
313: 
314:   if (coreclk)
315:     {
316:       putreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_CLKSOURCE | NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_TICKINT,
317:                NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
318:     }
319:   else
320:     {
321:       putreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_TICKINT, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
322:     }
323:

226:  *   also is used to eliminate error build-up from small errors in interval

91:       defined(CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS)

55:  *   (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).  Having a start-up function such as this for the
56:  *   IDLE is not really an architectural necessity.  It is used only for
57:  *   symmetry with how other threads are started (see nxtask_start() and
58:  *   pthread_start()).
59:  *
60:  * Input Parameters:

68: void nx_idle_trampoline(void)

70: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION_SWITCH
71:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb = this_task();

74: 
75:   sched_note_start(tcb);
76: #endif
77: 
78:   /* wait until cpu0 in idle() */
79: 
80:   while (!OSINIT_IDLELOOP());
81: 
82:   sched_unlock();
83: 
84:   /* Enter the IDLE loop */
85: 
86:   sinfo("CPU%d: Beginning Idle Loop\n", this_cpu());
87: 
88:   for (; ; )
89:     {

96: /****************************************************************************
97:  * Name: nx_smp_start
98:  *
99:  * Description:
100:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
101:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion
102:  *   of the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal
103:  *   multitasking, the additional CPUs would be started by calling this
104:  *   function.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   None
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:
110:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
111:  *
112:  * Assumption:
113:  *   Runs before the full initialization sequence has completed.  Runs after
114:  *   all OS facilities are set up, but before multi-tasking has been started.
115:  *
116:  ****************************************************************************/
117: 
118: int nx_smp_start(void)
119: {
120:   int ret;
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   /* Flush dcache before start other CPUs. */
124: 
125:   up_flush_dcache_all();
126: 
127:   /* Start all of the other CPUs.  CPU0 is already running. */
128: 
129:   for (cpu = 1; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)

52: /****************************************************************************
53:  * Name:  nxsched_cpu_scheduler
54:  *
55:  * Description:
56:  *   Check for operations specific to scheduling policy of the currently
57:  *   active task on one CPU.
58:  *
59:  * Input Parameters:
60:  *   cpu - The CPU that we are performing the scheduler operations on.
61:  *
62:  * Returned Value:
63:  *   None
64:  *
65:  ****************************************************************************/
66: 
67: #if CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL > 0 || defined(CONFIG_SCHED_SPORADIC)
68: static inline void nxsched_cpu_scheduler(int cpu)
69: {
70:   FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb = current_task(cpu);
71: 
72: #if CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL > 0
73:   /* Check if the currently executing task uses round robin scheduling. */
74: 
75:   if ((atomic_read(&rtcb->flags) & TCB_FLAG_POLICY_MASK) ==
76:       TCB_FLAG_SCHED_RR)
77:     {
78:       /* Yes, check if the currently executing task has exceeded its
79:        * timeslice.
80:        */
81: 
82:       nxsched_process_roundrobin(rtcb, 1, false);
83:     }
84: #endif
85: 
86: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_SPORADIC
87:   /* Check if the currently executing task uses sporadic scheduling. */
88: 
89:   if ((atomic_read(&rtcb->flags) & TCB_FLAG_POLICY_MASK) ==
90:       TCB_FLAG_SCHED_SPORADIC)
91:     {
92:       /* Yes, check if the currently executing task has exceeded its
93:        * budget.
94:        */
95: 
96:       nxsched_process_sporadic(rtcb, 1, false);
97:     }
98: #endif
99: }
100: #endif
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name:  nxsched_process_scheduler
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Check for operations specific to scheduling policy of the currently
107:  *   active task on all configured CPUs.
108:  *
109:  * Input Parameters:
110:  *   None
111:  *
112:  * Returned Value:
113:  *   None
114:  *
115:  ****************************************************************************/
116: 
117: #if CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL > 0 || defined(CONFIG_SCHED_SPORADIC)
118: static inline void nxsched_process_scheduler(void)
119: {
120:   irqstate_t flags;
121:   int i;
122: 
123:   /* Single CPU case:
124:    * For nested interrupts, higher IRQs may interrupt nxsched_cpu_scheduler()
125:    * but nxsched_cpu_scheduler() requires that interrupts be disabled.
126:    * We are in ISR context, no meaning we are disabled the interrupts.
127:    *
128:    * SMP case:
129:    * enter_critical_section() does much more than just disable interrupts on
130:    * the local CPU; it also manages spinlocks to assure the stability of the
131:    * TCB that we are manipulating.
132:    */
133: 
134:   flags = enter_critical_section();
135: 
136:   /* Perform scheduler operations on all CPUs */
137: 
138:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; i++)
139:     {
140:       nxsched_cpu_scheduler(i);
141:     }
142: 
143:   leave_critical_section(flags);
144: }
145: #else
146: #  define nxsched_process_scheduler()
147: #endif

328:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
329:     {
330:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
331:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
332:         {
333:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
334:           g_recovery_index = i;
335:           break;
336:         }
337:     }
338: 
339:   if (epoch == NULL)
340:     {
341:       uint32_t newest = 0;
342: 
343:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
344:         {
345:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
346:             {
347:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
348:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
349:               g_recovery_index = i;
350:             }
351:         }
352: 
353:       epoch->replay = true;
354:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
355:     }
356:   else
357:     {
358:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
359:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
360:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
361:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
362:     }
363: 
364:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
365:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
366:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
367:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
368:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
369: }
370: 
371: static void begin_abort(int result)
372: {
373:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
374: 
375:   if (g_active.busy)
376:     {
377:       g_active.quarantine = true;
378:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
379:     }
380: 
381:   if (probe != NULL)
382:     {
383:       probe->quarantine = true;
384:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
385:     }
386: 
387:   fail_pending(result);
388:   g_probe_requested = false;
389:   select_recovery_epoch();
390: }
391: 
392: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
393: {
394:   unsigned int i;
395: 
396:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
397:     {
398:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
399:         {
400:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
401:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
402:         }
403:     }
404: 
405:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
406:   return NULL;
407: }
408: 
409: static int dispatch_locked(void)
410: {
411:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
412:   struct active_transaction *active;
413:   struct logical_channel *channel;
414:   unsigned int i;
415:   int ret;
416: 
417:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
418: 
419:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
420:     {
421:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
422:         {
423:           continue;
424:         }
425: 
426:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
427:       if (ret < 0)
428:         {
429:           return ret;
430:         }
431: 
432:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
433:     }
434: 
435:   if (g_reset_pending)
436:     {
437:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
438:       if (ret < 0)
439:         {
440:           return ret;
441:         }
442: 
443:       g_reset_pending = false;
444:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
445:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
446:     }
447: 
448:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
449:     {
450:       return OK;
451:     }
452: 
453:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
454:     {
455:       channel = &g_channels[i];
456:       if (!channel->queued)
457:         {
458:           continue;
459:         }
460: 
461:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
462:         {
463:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
464:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
465:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
466:             {
467:               continue;
468:             }
469: 
470:           active = &epoch->probe;
471:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
472:             {
473:               return -ENOLINK;
474:             }
475:         }
476:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
477:         {
478:           active = &g_active;
479:           if (active->quarantine)
480:             {
481:               return -ENOLINK;
482:             }
483:         }
484:       else
485:         {
486:           return OK;
487:         }
488: 
489:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
490:         {
491:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
492:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
493:                  sizeof(active->message));
494:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
495:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
496:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
497:             g_channel_ids[i]);
498:         }
499: 
500:       active->callback = channel->callback;
501:       active->arg = channel->arg;
502:       active->channel_index = i;
503:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
504:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
505:       if (ret < 0)
506:         {
507:           return ret;
508:         }
509: 
510:       active->busy = true;
511:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
512:         {
513:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
514:             {
515:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
516:             }
517: 
518:           g_probe_attempts++;
519:           g_stats.probes++;
520:         }
521: 
522:       return OK;
523:     }
524: 
525:   return OK;
526: }
527: 
528: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
529:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
530: {
531:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
532: 
533:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
534:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
535:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
536:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
537:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
538:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
539:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
540: }
541: 
542: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
543: {
544:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
545:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
546:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
547: }
548: 
549: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
550: {
551:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
552:   struct active_transaction *active;
553:   bool replay;
554:   int result;
555: 
556:   active = busy_probe();
557:   if (active == NULL)
558:     {
559:       active = &g_active;
560:     }
561: 
562:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
563:     {
564:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
565:       return;
566:     }
567: 
568:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
569:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
570:     {
571:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
572: 
573:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
574:       return;
575:     }
576: 
577:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
578:     {
579:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
580:       return;
581:     }
582: 
583:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
584:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
585: 
586:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
587:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
588:     {
589:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
590:     }
591: 
592:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
593:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
594:   if (replay)
595:     {
596:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
597:       unsigned int i;
598: 
599:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
600:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
601:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
602:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
603:        */
604: 
605:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
606:       g_active.quarantine = false;
607:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
608:         {
609:           if (i != replay_index)
610:             {
611:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
612:             }
613:         }
614: 
615:       select_recovery_epoch();
616:       (void)dispatch_locked();
617:       return;
618:     }
619: 
620:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
621: 
622:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
623:     {
624:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
625:         {
626:           release_recovery_slots();
627:           g_recovery_index = 0;
628:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
629:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
630:         }
631:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
632:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
633:         {
634:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
635:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
636:            */
637:         }
638:       else
639:         {
640:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
641:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
642:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
643:         }
644:     }
645: 
646:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
647:            result < 0)
648:     {
649:       begin_abort(result);
650:     }
651: 
652:   (void)dispatch_locked();
653: }
654: 
655: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
656: {
657:   struct ack_slot *slot;
658:   unsigned int rx_index;
659:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
660:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
661:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
662:   uint8_t state = 0;
663:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
664: 
665:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
666:     {
667:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
668:       if (slot == NULL)
669:         {
670:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
671:           return -EAGAIN;
672:         }
673:     }
674:   else
675:     {
676:       slot = NULL;
677:     }
678: 
679:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
680:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
681:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
682:     {
683:       g_stats.bad_header++;
684:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
685:     }
686:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
687:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
688:     {
689:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
690:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
691:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
692:         {
693:           if (slot != NULL)
694:             {
695:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
696:             }
697: 
698:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
699:           return -EAGAIN;
700:         }
701:       else if (ret < 0)
702:         {
703:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
704:         }
705:     }
706:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
707:     {
708:       g_pwc_rx(message);
709:       ret = OK;
710:     }
711:   else
712:     {
713:       g_stats.unsupported++;
714:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
715:     }
716: 
717:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
718:     {
719:       return OK;
720:     }
721: 
722:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
723:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
724:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
725:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
726:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
727: 
728:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
729:     {
730:       g_probe_requested = true;
731:     }
732: 
733:   (void)dispatch_locked();
734:   return OK;
735: }
736: 
737: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
738: {
739:   irqstate_t flags;
740:   uint8_t control;
741: 
742:   flags = up_irq_save();
743:   g_stats.rx++;
744:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
745: 
746:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
747:     {
748:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
749:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
750:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
751:         {
752:           g_stats.bad_header++;
753:         }
754:       else
755:         {
756:           g_stats.resets++;
757:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
758:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
759:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
760:         }
761:     }
762:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
763:     {
764:       handle_ack(message);
765:     }
766:   else
767:     {
768:       int ret = handle_command(message);
769: 
770:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
771:         {
772:           up_irq_restore(flags);
773:           return ret;
774:         }
775:     }
776: 
777:   up_irq_restore(flags);
778:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
779:   return OK;
780: }

782: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
783: {
784:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
785: 
786:   (void)argc;
787:   (void)argv;
788:   for (;;)
789:     {
790:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
791:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
792:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
793:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
794:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
795:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
796:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
797:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
798: 
799:       up_irq_restore(flags);
800:       if (reported == state)
801:         {
802:           continue;
803:         }
804: 
805:       reported = state;
806:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
807:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
808:         {
809:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
810:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
811:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
812:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
813:         }
814: 
815:       if (callback != NULL)
816:         {
817:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
818:         }
819:     }
820: 
821:   return OK;
822: }

824: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
825: {
826:   (void)argc;
827:   (void)argv;
828: 
829:   for (;;)
830:     {
831:       struct active_transaction *probe;
832:       irqstate_t flags;
833:       bool request_probe;
834: 
835:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
836:       flags = up_irq_save();
837: 
838:       probe = busy_probe();
839:       if ((g_active.busy &&
840:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
841:           (probe != NULL &&
842:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
843:         {
844:           g_stats.timeout++;
845:           if (probe != NULL)
846:             {
847:               probe->quarantine = true;
848:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
849:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
850:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
851:             }
852:           else
853:             {
854:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
855:             }
856:         }
857: 
858:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
859:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
860:         {
861:           select_recovery_epoch();
862:         }
863: 
864:       (void)dispatch_locked();
865:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
866:         {
867:           g_probe_requested = false;
868:         }
869: 
870:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
871:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
872:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
873:       if (request_probe)
874:         {
875:           g_probe_requested = false;
876:         }
877: 
878:       up_irq_restore(flags);
879: 
880:       if (request_probe)
881:         {
882:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
883:         }
884:     }
885: 
886:   return OK;
887: }

951: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
952:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
953:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
954: {
955:   struct logical_channel *channel;
956:   unsigned int index;
957:   irqstate_t flags;
958:   int ret;
959: 
960:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
961:     {
962:       return -EAGAIN;
963:     }
964: 
965:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
966:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
967:     {
968:       return -EINVAL;
969:     }
970: 
971:   flags = up_irq_save();
972:   channel = &g_channels[index];
973:   if (channel->queued)
974:     {
975:       up_irq_restore(flags);
976:       return -EBUSY;
977:     }
978: 
979:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
980:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
981:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
982:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
983:     {
984:       up_irq_restore(flags);
985:       return -ENOLINK;
986:     }
987: 
988:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
989:     {
990:       up_irq_restore(flags);
991:       return -ENOLINK;
992:     }
993: 
994:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
995:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
996:   channel->callback = callback;
997:   channel->arg = arg;
998:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
999:   channel->queued = true;
1000:   ret = dispatch_locked();
1001:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
1002:     {
1003:       channel->queued = false;
1004:       channel->result = ret;
1005:     }
1006: 
1007:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1008:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1009:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
1010: }

1012: int bk7258_mailbox_register_rx(uint8_t logical_channel,
